verdict.rationale: Firebase's own Local Emulator Suite runs Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Storage, Authentication, Hosting, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions locally, so apps can connect to it for integration testing and QA without touching production data [firebase-docs-24, firebase-docs-9]. A Test SDK loads Security Rules and flushes local data between tests [firebase-docs-31, firebase-docs-46], and firebase-tools adds a CLI local Hosting server alongside one-command deploy [firebase-gh-1, firebase-docs-8]. Missing for 10: Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions emulation are still beta, the pack does not show emulation for the rest of the stack (e.g. SQL Connect, AI services), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the emulator workflow.
